00044 SpawnBaseUGenInternal::SpawnBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, const int _numChannels, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00045 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(numInputs, _numChannels-1),
00046     numChannels(_numChannels),
00047     currentEventIndex(0),
00048     maxRepeats_(maxRepeats),
00049     bufferData(new float*[numChannels]),
00050     stopEvents(false)
00051 {
00052     ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00053     ugen_assert(maxRepeats >= 0);
00054     initEvents();
00055 }
00056 
00057 SpawnBaseUGenInternal::~SpawnBaseUGenInternal()// throw()
00058 {
00059     delete [] bufferData;
00060 }
00061 
00062 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00063 {       
00064     if(reachedMaxRepeats() == true && events.sizeNotNull() == 0) shouldDelete = true;
00065     
00066     if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00067     
00068     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00069     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00070     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00071     {
00072         bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00073     }
00074     
00075     mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00076     mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00077     mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00078 }
00079 
00080 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::releaseInternal() throw()
00081 {
00082     UGenInternal::releaseInternal();
00083     mixer.release();

00086 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::stealInternal() throw()
00087 {

00092 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::initEvents() throw()
00093 {
00094     events = UGen::emptyChannels(numChannels);
00095     mixer = Mix(&events, false);
00096     stopEvents = false;
00097 }

00099 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::stopAllEvents() throw()

00104 SpawnUGenInternal::SpawnUGenInternal(const int numChannels, const double nextTime_, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00105 :   SpawnBaseUGenInternal(0, numChannels, maxRepeats),
00106     nextTime(nextTime_),
00107     nextTimeSamples(0)
00108 {
00109     ugen_assert(nextTime >= 0.0)
00110 }
00111 
00112 void SpawnUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00113 {
00114     // render the current voices
00115     SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00116     
00117     const unsigned int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00118     const unsigned int nextBlockID = blockID + blockSize;
00119     
00120     if(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false)
00121     {
00122         // now overdub new voices this block
00123             
00124         if(nextTimeSamples < blockID)
00125             nextTimeSamples = blockID;
00126         
00127         const int blockOffset = nextTimeSamples - blockID;
00128         int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize - blockOffset;  
00129         const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00130         
00131         if(blockOffset > 0)
00132         {
00133             for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00134             {
00135                 bufferData[channel] += blockOffset;
00136             }
00137         }
00138         
00139         do
00140         {
00141             UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++);
00142             newVoice.prepareForBlock(blockSize, blockID); // prepare for full size (allocates the output buffers)
00143             
00144             UGen::setBlockSize(numSamplesToProcess);
00145             newVoice.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, nextTimeSamples); // prepare for sub block
00146             
00147             unsigned int nextTimeSamplesDelta = (unsigned int)(nextTime * UGen::getSampleRate());
00148             
00149             for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00150             {
00151                 bool shouleDeleteLocal = false;
00152                 float *voiceSamples = newVoice.processBlock(shouleDeleteLocal, nextTimeSamples, channel);
00153                 accumulateSamples(bufferData[channel], voiceSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00154                 bufferData[channel] += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00155             }
00156             
00157             events <<= newVoice;
00158             
00159             numSamplesToProcess -= nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00160             nextTimeSamples += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00161         } 
00162         while(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false);
00163         
00164         UGen::setBlockSize(blockSize); // reset
00165         
00166         mixer = Mix(&events, false);        
00167     }
00168 }
